name: ThawiKayhiGan Group LP
community: Six northern Ontario First Nations; main office at Fort William First Nation
description: Northern Ontario general contracting, procurement, winter-road logistics and project partnerships. Company website identifies six founding First Nations and lists its main office at Fort William First Nation. Ownership and precise reserve-land status remain pending direct verification.
ownership_type: Unverified — official business website states 100% First Nations ownership by six founding First Nations
ownership_evidence: The company's About page identifies Thawikayhigan LP (TKG) as 100% First Nations owned, founded by Kingfisher Lake, Kasabonika Lake, Kitchenuhmaykoosib Inninuwug, Wapekeka, Wawakapewin and Wunnumin Lake First Nations. This is self-reported evidence, not independent ownership verification.
on_reserve_location_evidence: The company's official Contact page lists a main office at 684 City Road Unit 1, Fort William First Nation, Ontario, and a satellite office in Thunder Bay. The exact legal reserve-land status of the main office has not been independently confirmed; no address is reproduced in the directory record.
review_notes: Reviewed October 31, 2026 against official company About and Contact pages. No residential address; public office location evidence is not treated as verified reserve-land status. Strong aliases to exclude include Thawikayhigan LP and TKG Group LP.
